title: Personal Data

chapter_outcomes: What personal data is, including: why personal data should be kept confidential
Keeping personal data secure, including: how personal data can be kept confidential, including the removal of geotags from photos/videos

Uses of malware including: fraud, industrial espionage, sabotage
Consequences of malware for organisations and individuals
Prevention of malware including software and physical
